chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukayr, from one of our companions, that he asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the Tamattu', 'When does it occur?'
He (peace be upon him) said: 'He performs Tamattu' as long as he thinks he can catch up with the people at Mina.'

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)
key_terms.التَّمَتُّع: Tamattu' (a form of Hajj combining Umrah and Hajj with a separation)
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina (a location near Mecca central to Hajj rituals)

ai.seo_question: When does the time for Tamattu' end according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the temporal boundary for the validity of Tamattu' Hajj, linking it to the pilgrim's reasonable expectation of reaching Mina with the main congregation. In Shia jurisprudence, this subjective criterion ('what he believes') provides flexibility, ensuring the ritual remains valid as long as the pilgrim has not missed the essential gathering, reflecting the practical ease intended by the Imams. This definition is crucial for determining the specific day of Dhu al-Hijjah when the Hajj rites transition from Umrah to the core Hajj rituals.
